from.place: Proof, final paragraph beginning 'For another compactification': compatibility of comparison isomorphisms with refinement maps; via closed-proper-support locality, properness descends from etale refinements. The quasi-compactness component of properness.

title: Universally closed scheme morphisms are quasi-compact
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $f$ is universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $f$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]: for every affine open $V\subseteq S$, the inverse image $f^{-1}(V)$ is quasi-compact.
